Lord Byron (1788–1824).  Poetry of Byron.  1881.

IV. Satiric

On my thirty-third Birthday

January 22, 1821
T
HROUGH
 life’s dull road, so dim and dirty,
I have dragg’d to three and thirty.
What have these years left to me?
Nothing—except thirty-three.
